as_told.title: Taylor works for the Hammer, who works for God

plain: A man named Timothy Taylor is said to have claimed that he worked for someone called "the Hammer," a figure nobody seems able to identify. Chris Bledsoe, a man the show presents as someone who draws UFOs to him, says Taylor told him this directly, around 2008 to 2011: "I work for the hammer and the hammer works for God." Bledsoe links it to the film The Adjustment Bureau and the story it came from, The Adjustment Team, which are about hidden agents who steer people's lives. A guest named Bob McGwier repeats the story as he heard it from Bledsoe, adding that "no one that I know knows who the hammer is."
